# Official CPython source fixtures

These files are inert input data from CPython 3.13.12, not imported Python or
compiled C. Each `.source` file retains the exact upstream bytes. The upstream
license is included in `LICENSE`.

Archive SHA-256:
`2a84cd31dd8d8ea8aaff75de66fc1b4b0127dd5799aa50a64ae9a313885b4593`.

The fixed Linux subprocess profile records the individual source hashes and
required initializer/header relationships. Runtime and build acceptance are
separate.
